onboarding.voiceWelcome: Welcome to SafePay. You dey the home screen. Double tap Speak Balance make you hear your money, or use the MoMo Services tiles to send money, hear your statement, buy airtime or cash out.
onboarding.welcomeBody: You welcome to SafePay. SafePay go read your money give you, and your PIN no dey talk at all. This setup no too long. You fit use your voice or your hand.
onboarding.micBody: Make SafePay use the microphone? E dey listen while the app dey open, so you go fit talk your command.
onboarding.micGranted: The microphone don gree. SafePay fit hear your voice.
onboarding.micDenied: No wahala. You fit allow the microphone later inside Settings.
onboarding.micPermanent: Them don off the microphone for SafePay. Go on for your phone settings, then open SafePay again.
onboarding.listeningTitle: E dey listen all the time
onboarding.listeningBody: While SafePay dey open, the microphone dey on. You no go need find any button. Talk gyae or stop, make SafePay keep quiet.
onboarding.skipHint: Double-tap make you skip this step
onboarding.contactsBody: Later, if you talk person name, SafePay fit find im number. The first time wey you use am, SafePay go ask you. Your contacts no comot from your phone.
onboarding.talkbackTitle: How you dey move for screen?
onboarding.talkbackBody: How you wan dey move for screen?
onboarding.srOff: Your screen reader dey off. SafePay go talk by imsef.
onboarding.micTestBody: Talk anything. For example: hello SafePay.
onboarding.micTestRetry: I no hear anything. Talk am again, small loud.
onboarding.voiceTestOk: Good. You fit change volume anytime.
onboarding.voiceTestNo: Make the volume high, then listen again.
onboarding.bioBody: SafePay dey confirm every payment with your fingerprint. Your PIN no dey talk.
onboarding.bioNone: This phone no get fingerprint. SafePay go use your voice confirm.
onboarding.bioNotEnrolled: You no enroll any fingerprint. You fit add one inside your phone settings, under Security. SafePay go use your voice until then.
onboarding.bioSuccess: Fingerprint gree. Your money dey safe.
onboarding.bioFailed: The fingerprint no match. You fit try again anytime.
onboarding.bioLockout: You try too many times. Wait small.
onboarding.teachBody: Three commands. Talk: me sika a aka, make you hear your balance. Talk: kɔma sika, make you send money. Talk: gyae, make SafePay quiet.
onboarding.teachBalance: Yes! Me sika a aka na the balance command.
onboarding.teachSend: Yes! Kɔma sika na the send money command.
onboarding.teachAgain: Try again. The commands be: me sika a aka, kɔma sika, gyae.
onboarding.doneBody: SafePay don ready. Your balance and your transactions fit read aloud, and your PIN no dey talk. Talk me sika a aka make you hear your balance.
onboarding.exited: Setup pause. You fit run am again inside Settings.
